mapper.select: SELECT v.id,v.active_index_revision FROM ai_knowledge_document_version v JOIN ai_knowledge_document d ON d.id=v.document_id AND d.tenant_id=v.tenant_id JOIN ai_knowledge_base b ON b.id=d.knowledge_base_id AND b.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.enabled=1 AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND v.active_index_revision IS NOT NULL AND b.id=#{knowledgeBaseId}
